user.title: Add a host
user.description: SSH access with an account allowed to use sudo (or root). These credentials are used once to create a restricted account for Home Assistant and are not stored.

host_key.title: Confirm the host identity
host_key.description:
Check that this SSH host key fingerprint belongs to **{host}** (`ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` on the host):

`{fingerprint}`

| | |
|---|---|
| Hostname | {hostname} |
| System | {os} ({arch}) |
| Python | {python} |
| smartctl | {smartctl} |
| Installed agent | {installed} |

The key is pinned: any later change will be refused.

agent.title: Agent settings
agent.description: MQTT broker the agent on **{hostname}** connects to. Use an address reachable from that host and preferably a dedicated MQTT account.

data.language: Language of entity names and messages

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {host}
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer administer the agent (key refused or host key changed). Give an account allowed to use sudo again: a new restricted key is created.

reauth_host_key.title: Host key changed
reauth_host_key.description:
The SSH host key of **{host}** has CHANGED. Only accept it if you reinstalled the system or regenerated its keys.

New fingerprint: `{fingerprint}`

progress.install: Setting up {hostname}: accounts, helper, agent installation, then waiting for the agent to report over MQTT (up to 2 minutes).

error.auth_required: Give a password or a private key.
error.invalid_key: The private key cannot be read (it must be an unencrypted OpenSSH key).
error.sudo_failed: This account cannot use sudo with the given password.

abort.no_systemd: systemd is required on the host.
abort.python_too_old: Python 3.11 or newer is required on the host (found {python}).
abort.bundle_missing: The agent archive is missing from the integration: {detail}
abort.host_key_changed: The SSH host key changed during the setup.
abort.admin_login_failed: The restricted account 'host-agent-admin' cannot log in ({detail}). Check AllowUsers/AllowGroups in sshd_config.
abort.agent_not_reporting: The agent is installed but does not report over MQTT. Check that {detail} is reachable from the host and the MQTT credentials, then retry.

data.language: Language of entity names and messages

smart.title: Disks
smart.description: Changes are validated by the agent on the host before being saved. {detail}

data.selftest_max_age_hours: Warn when no successful self-test for (0 = never)

data_description.selftest_window: Local time, HH:MM-HH:MM (may cross midnight), empty = any time.
data_description.interval_minutes: Keep it long on USB bridges: frequent reads can abort self-tests.

data_description.required: A missing mountpoint is a critical issue, e.g. /bkup/dirvish.

data.max_age_hours: Maximum age of the last successful backup

job_edit.title: Job
job_edit.description: **File**: the newest file matching the pattern is the last run (e.g. a log). **Report**: the job calls `host-agent report "job name" [--failed]` when it ends. {detail}

data.name: Name
data.max_age_hours: Maximum age of the last successful run

data_description.success_pattern: Searched at the end of the file, e.g. total size is

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: `collectors` section of the agent configuration (same syntax as config.example.yaml). {detail}

error.warning_above_critical: The warning threshold must not exceed the critical one.
error.duplicate_job: A job with this name already exists.

host_key_changed.title: SSH host key changed on {host}
host_key_changed.description: Home Assistant refused to connect to {host} because its SSH host key changed. This happens after a reinstallation, but can also reveal an attack. Re-authenticate the integration to accept the new key.

protocol_mismatch.title: Agent on {host} is incompatible
protocol_mismatch.description: The agent uses protocol {agent}, this integration expects {integration}. Install the agent update from the device page.
